body_es: SQL avanzado incluye CTEs (Common Table Expressions), window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD) y operaciones complejas de join. Las CTEs mejoran legibilidad permitiendo definir subconsultas nomb radas reutilizables. Las window functions calculan valores sobre particiones de datos sin agrupar, ideales para rangos, correlaciones y análisis de tendencias.
body_en: Advanced SQL includes CTEs, window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD) and complex join operations. CTEs improve readability by allowing reusable named subqueries. Window functions calculate values over data partitions without grouping, ideal for ranks, correlations and trend analysis.
example_code:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT month, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month) as running_total
  FROM sales
)
SELECT month, amount, running_total,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) as rank
FROM monthly_sales
example_output: Resultado con totales acumulativos y ranking de ventas, combinando transformaciones complejas en una sola query eficiente.
